checked: OSU Kappler text: Treaty with the Chickasaw, July 23, 1805, 7 Stat. 89, ratified May 22, proclaimed May 23, 1807; Article 1 one mile square reserved below Duck River for O'Koy; Article 2 $20,000, $1,000 each to George Colbert and O'Koy, $100 life annuity to Chinubbee Mingo, in specie; Article 3 $2 a day to the Chickasaw boundary representative; Article 4 no settlement on the described part for three years. Matches.
ICC Docket 267 opinion (Sept. 16, 1957, OSU id 572) title confirms it is a Chickasaw docket unrelated to this cession.
